movie.title: Victorian Psycho
movie.overview: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When an eccentric young governess with hidden psychopathic tendencies arrives at a remote Victorian manor, her violent inner urges begin to unravel the household's aristocratic calm.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In 1858, an eccentric governess named Winifred Notty takes up a position at Ensor House to care for the children of the wealthy Pound family. Behind her demure facade, Winifred harbors violent psychopathic tendencies and an inner persona she lovingly nurtures. As members of the manor's staff begin mysteriously disappearing, the self-absorbed employers slowly suspect something is deeply amiss with their new employee. Winifred's unhinged dark fantasies and brutal acts threaten to completely dismantle the estate's rigid Victorian order.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In 1858, young governess Winifred Notty arrives at the sprawling Gothic estate of Ensor House to tutor the children of the wealthy Pound family. On the surface, Winifred presents herself as a polite and eager educator who teaches table manners and family history. Beneath her proper exterior, however, Winifred secretly harbors dangerous, violent impulses driven by an inner dark persona. She quickly befriends the innocent family maid while simultaneously alarming the children with eerie lessons on suffering and morality. Unsettling events soon plague the manor, ranging from mutilated livestock to strange occurrences in the dead of night. When members of the estate staff begin to vanish without a trace, panic and suspicion begin to simmer beneath the surface. The elitist Mr. and Mrs. Pound remain largely oblivious, distracted by their own snobbish preoccupations and absurd upper-class cruelties. As Winifred's grasp on her civilized persona slips, her bloody acts escalate in scale and savagery. What begins as a desperate quest for acceptance devolves into a chaotic wave of macabre violence. Ultimately, the delicate Victorian veneer of Ensor House shatters completely under the fury of Winifred's unleashed madness.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set in Victorian England in 1858, Victorian Psycho follows Winifred Notty, an eccentric governess who takes up employment at Ensor House, the grand Gothic estate of the aristocratic Pound family. Tasked with teaching the young heirs table manners, history, and social etiquette, Winifred strives to project the picture of a demure, dedicated domestic tutor eager to integrate into polite society. However, beneath her polished appearance lies a deeply disturbed mind battling violent, murderous urges that she attributes to an internal entity. As Winifred assimilates into household life and interacts with both the cold, class-obsessed owners and the vulnerable domestic staff, strange and horrifying incidents begin to disrupt the quiet routine of the manor. Unexplained disappearances and unsettling acts of violence soon stir growing suspicion throughout the house. Blending dark gothic horror with biting social satire, the story explores female rage, class conflict, and the hypocrisies of Victorian elite culture as a killer walks the halls of Ensor House.

story_structure.climax: The simmering tension reaches a boiling point in a decisive confrontation where the true nature of Winifred and the danger looming over the manor are dramatically exposed.
story_structure.conflict: A series of unsettling and mysterious events begins to disturb the manor, driving the household to suspect that Winifred is hiding her true identity and motives.
story_structure.resolution: In the violent aftermath, the remnants of the household contend with the truth, establishing the final status of the estate and Winifred's fate.
story_structure.introduction: Eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, establishing her place in the eerie household and introducing the dreary, secluded setting.
story_structure.risingAction: As paranoia deepens, secret suspicions intensify and tensions rise while the residents attempt to investigate Winifred, revealing increasingly dangerous undercurrents within the estate.
